chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir who said:

I asked him about a man who did not know how to shorten [his hair] or shave [his head] until he departed from Mina. He said, 'Let him return to Mina until he shaves his hair there or shortens it, and he must shave the back of his neck (al-sarurah).'

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina (a location near Mecca central to Hajj rituals)

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he forgets to shave or shorten his hair before leaving Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ruling for a pilgrim who neglects the final rite of *halq* or *taqsir* in Mina due to ignorance, mandating a return to Mina to complete the act. Notably, it specifies that while the head hair must be addressed in Mina, the *sarurah* (the small patch of hair at the nape of the neck) is to be shaved separately, reflecting the detailed jurisprudence of the Imams regarding the completeness of the ritual. This ruling underscores the principle that missing a specific pillar or condition of Hajj due to forgetfulness or ignorance requires rectification at the site rather than a full redo of the pilgrimage.
